# Gotchas

Traps, bugs and errors grouped by area of the system (one file per area), with symptom, cause and fix. Read the area's file before changing that area.

## Files

- [agent.md](agent.md) — **Agent gotchas**: Traps in the agent loop - a deadline check with `<` let a normal step start with 0 s at exactly the finish reserve (now `<=`).
- [api.md](api.md) — **API gotchas**: Traps in the HTTP API layer: FastAPI returns 400 (not 422) for a body that is not UTF-8, so an always-200 endpoint must parse its own body.
- [build.md](build.md) — **Build gotchas**: Traps with uv installs: `uv sync` is exact by default and strips dev tools from a shared .venv when run with --no-dev.
- [embeddings.md](embeddings.md) — **Embedding gotchas**: Traps with Gemini embeddings and S9: a list of plain strings is embedded as ONE vector (each text must be its own Content); our own limiter (120 requests/min) sets the pace and 429s start a little above ~5M tokens/min; a cached S9 still spends ~23 s on the cache pass; and four fixed Codex findings: S9's error boundary missed the writer's open/close, concurrent calls could pass the spend cap, the real client's rejected answers bypassed S9's handling, cached vectors skipped the unit checks.
- [eval.md](eval.md) — **Eval gotchas**: Traps in the eval tooling. Tests - test_no_hardcoding and test_eval_split once read the full dev-question file on every check (now one-way hashes in tests/fixtures/forbidden_tokens.sha256 and the tune/smoke id files only). /ask eval runner (eval/run.py) - per-question trace spans of protected (heldout, all) runs leaked per-question results into Langfuse; extra args after a `uv run` key could override its `--set` (argparse keeps the last value); deeply nested JSON raised RecursionError and aborted the whole run. Retrieval eval - a screened (subset) index was reused for a question set with other gold documents until its manifest held a digest of the kept ids; NaN and infinite fusion weights passed a `< 0` check; `:g` gave different weights the same run name; older reports without per-question recall could not be rendered (now `n/a`).
- [ingestion.md](ingestion.md) — **Ingestion gotchas**: Traps in the ingestion pipeline: lone surrogates from JSON escapes broke the SQLite write and failed the whole build (fixed; non-UTF-8 file names on Linux still open), folder links made S1 depend on listing order, two servers on one checkout can break each other's index, stage counts live in ingest_stages not the log, value-only kind rules need lookalike tests, a fixed chunk overlap broke small sizes, chat epoch timestamps are mostly fake, and short date role words matched inside longer words.
- [llm.md](llm.md) — **LLM (chat model) gotchas**: Traps with Gemini chat calls through google-genai - a model turn rebuilt without thought signatures is refused with 400 (re-send raw, or put the stand-in signature on the first function call); the SDK sends two fields in snake_case on the wire; a genai.Client that nothing references closes its HTTP client ("client has been closed"). Embedding traps are in embeddings.md.
- [retrieval.md](retrieval.md) — **Retrieval gotchas**: Traps in the agent's search and the store reads behind it - SQLite FTS5 with a long `rowid IN (...)` list is very slow (23.7 s for 25,000 ids), so scoped BM25 reads every match and filters in Python.
- [server.md](server.md) — **Server gotchas**: Traps when running the uvicorn server: after a graceful SIGTERM shutdown the exit code is 143, not 0; and a port already bound on 127.0.0.1 by another process hides our server (bound on 0.0.0.0) from local probes.
- [tests.md](tests.md) — **Test gotchas**: Traps when testing: TestClient never binds a socket and httpx ASGITransport skips the lifespan; the serve contract test greps a start-up log phrase; shutil.copytree keeps file times, so copied fixture corpora share one index fingerprint; and the generality test's renaming helper gives the empty key a name; and an invented test source with 100+ ISO dates moves the learned date window (use epochs for a date meant to fall outside it); a test name thought to be invented was in the corpus (grep data/corpus first).
- [tooling.md](tooling.md) — **Tooling gotchas**: Traps with the project's tooling: import-linter forbids indirect imports by default (so no layer could import llm.client) and rejects an ignore line that matches no import; shell-script edits skip the format hook and the commit hook then fails; a shell command naming a protected file is blocked even inside a heredoc, and so is a shell wildcard into eval/results; a dataclass attribute named `field` hides dataclasses.field; agents cannot write .env.example (deny rule); the post-edit lint hook removes an import added before its first use, or one whose last use moved to a later edit; zsh does not word-split "--flag value" in a loop; a wait loop on `pgrep -f` matches itself; in a git-worktree session the isolation guard refuses complex inline scripts, the bare word eval and computed arguments (use scratchpad scripts); several agents in one worktree share its files and git index (format and commit by path only); the Write tool turns `\u` escapes into characters; ruff's print ban (T20) covers tests too; a new worktree has no .env (the user links it) and any command naming the key file is refused; a path commit takes another agent's lines in a shared file; the format hook once linted scratch files outside the repo (now skipped); the global harness guard once matched secret-file names across newlines and after a `>` redirect (patterns now stop at a newline and `>`; keep hook test data in files, never on the command line).
- [tracing.md](tracing.md) — **Tracing gotchas**: Traps with Langfuse 5, Langfuse Cloud and OpenTelemetry: the legacy read API (/api/public/traces) returns 410 on new orgs and the Hobby plan rate-limits the public API, FastAPI picks up OTel by itself, one Langfuse client per public key per process, flush/shutdown have no timeout, and the SDK logs the public key at INFO; the v2 Observations API returns input and output as JSON strings; no project command reads a trace back yet (a read-only test file through uv run tests-live does).
